tasks.instructions: Directions: Read the passage and choose the best answer (A, B, C, or D) for each question.

passage.title: Reading Part 1 - Test 03
passage.text:
TEXT A - Job Advertisement

Digital Marketing Specialist Wanted

Are you a creative and dynamic professional? We need someone to analyze campaigns and provide comprehensive reports. Minimum 3 years of relevant experience required. Competitive salary and benefits.

TEXT B - Travel Blog

My Perfect Weekend in Lakeside Town

This charming destination is just two hours from the city. The town is renowned for its crystal-clear lake. I stayed at a cozy bed-and-breakfast. The kayaking experience was absolutely serene - no crowds, just nature and tranquility.

TEXT C - Shopping Promotion

MEGA SPRING SALE!

Don't miss our most spectacular sale! Enjoy incredible discounts up to 70% off. Spend $200 and get a complimentary $30 gift card. Exclusive VIP benefits available!
